note.en: A small salt-marsh snail of the upper shore and mangrove litter, about 1.6 cm, from two museum records.
note.es: Un caracol de marisma pequeño de la orilla alta y la hojarasca del manglar, de unos 1,6 cm, de dos registros de museo.

evidence: GBIF: 2 records in the region (specimens and observations)
recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 2 records in the region (specimens and observations).

marks.en: Small, glossy, egg-shaped brown shell with a narrow opening and teeth inside; lives in mangroves and salt marsh.
marks.es: Concha pequena, brillante y ovalada, parda, con abertura estrecha y dientes por dentro; vive en manglares y marismas.
